name: bash
arguments:
{"command":"python3 - <<'PY'
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
import csv, io
pay='''record_id,regular_hours,overtime_hours,hourly_rate,deduction
EMP-001,159,7,31.19,202
EMP-002,145,6,27.4,165
EMP-003,158,7,42.76,168
EMP-004,130,9,23.1,138
EMP-005,144,4,23.06,173
EMP-006,148,9,40.39,174
EMP-007,154,10,32.54,138
EMP-008,150,2,36.51,231
EMP-009,156,8,45.9,191
EMP-010,143,6,32.84,207
'''
q=Decimal('.01'); ot=Decimal('1.73'); wh=Decimal('.2137')
s=Decimal(0); s2=Decimal(0)
for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(pay)):
 reg=Decimal(r['regular_hours']); over=Decimal(r['overtime_hours']); rate=Decimal(r['hourly_rate']); ded=Decimal(r['deduction'])
 gross=reg*rate+over*rate*ot
 net=gross*(1-wh)-ded
 gross_r=gross.quantize(q, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
 net_r=net.quantize(q, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
 net2=(gross_r*(1-wh)-ded).quantize(q,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
 s+=net_r;s2+=net2
 print(r['record_id'], gross, gross_r, net, net_r,net2)
print('totals direct',s,'rounded gross',s2)
PY"}
